design: Externally pinned benchmarks, outcomes unopened at registration; descriptive finite panel with equal weight within family. No replacement.

opf.model: Single-period full polar AC, reference angle fixed, nodal complex balance, original voltage, both-end thermal, angle and generator constraints and costs.
opf.baseline: Full unrestricted IPOPT, DC and flat starts; use small interior margins to permit validating a feasible AC witness. Lower bounds from nonnegative-loss dispatch then W-space polyhedral outer approximation of SOC and thermal disks, with independently evaluated rational duals. Exhaust fixed maximum of 12 cut rounds unless 1% excluded. Numerical incumbent alone cannot certify exact opportunity. Attempt validated existence using interval load flow.
opf.budgets: 30s per baseline start, 30s per LP call. Report certification overhead and end-to-end clocks including rebuilds separately.

uc.model: PGLib reference MILP, initial history, ramping, start categories, reserve, piecewise fuel and curtailment intact. No terminal state beyond published truncated horizon.
uc.baseline: Unrestricted HiGHS, single thread seed 61, 30s MILP call, 0.1% solver gap; compare full LP with independent rational weak-duality checker and feasible rational reconstruction. Solver-native bound retained separately. Try one split on most fractional on/off variable only for unresolved full-LP cases; min of two verified bounds. Do not equate native termination or floating residual checks with an exact certificate.

target: A cost reduction of at least 1.0% of the fixed feasible incumbent objective for the identical instance. Strict exclusion U-L < 0.01 U on positive costs. With a rigorous upper price for a witness, test 0.99 U < L. If unavailable, separate numerical diagnostic. Report wider secondary thresholds descriptively only.
falsification: Perturb a primal balance, perturb a multiplier or flip a bound endpoint; validate signed bound against feasible witnesses on controls. Compare nested exact bounds by taking max only over independently established lower bounds.
external_validity: No contingency security, networked UC, time coupling in AC, or claimed field savings. Timings on shared host. The two horizons of one UC date are dependent.
